tool_args.rationale: The branch measurements establish strong gradient dependence, while every row has the same horizon and fixed memory/history values. A fine trajectory batch is the relevant available probe to resolve the transfer dynamics before committing to a model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary saturating transfer model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The seven rows constrain the input response at one horizon, but only two gradient settings vary; they do not identify gradient modulation or the two-hop dynamics well enough for fresh confirmation.
The observations all use H=0.6, so the time evolution and coupled rates remain confounded.
It does not target the horizon or gradient identifiability gap and is explicitly unnecessary.
